decision_rules.development: reported descriptively only because the sign was selected from development
decision_rules.locked_validation_pass: risk-on rate in [15%,75%]; candidate annualized return>0; max-drawdown magnitude reduced>=15%; Sharpe improves>=0.15; annualized return no more than 1pp below F; weekly paired-return noninferiority one-sided HAC p<0.05; both subperiod candidate total returns>0 and paired total returns>=-2pp
decision_rules.cost_stress_pass: at 60bp locked-validation candidate annualized return>0 and max drawdown is lower than F
decision_rules.candidate_status: RETROSPECTIVE_DRAWDOWN_REENTRY_CANDIDATE_FORWARD_TEST_REQUIRED only if locked validation and cost stress pass
decision_rules.failure_status: HYPOTHESIS_FALSIFIED_LOCKED_VALIDATION; no alternate lookback, threshold, hysteresis, or leverage rescue
